question: Why does time fail to have a coherent intrinsic nature?
premises: Time never appears in an unconditioned form.
Time cannot be consistently defined as one or many.
Time cannot be consistently defined as permanent or impermanent.
inference: Time lacks a coherent intrinsic nature.
plain_english: Time has no coherent nature of its own, because it never appears without conditions and because it cannot be consistently established as one or many, permanent or impermanent.
